SnapshotLifecycle.description: Readiness and the current session; available without live clients.

SnapshotOperationRecord.description: Stored operation metadata, including partial failure and independent cleanup.

sessionId.description: Reset external providers and indexers for this replacement session.

intervalMining.description: Milliseconds between interval-mined slots; 0 is off.

finality.description: Beacon API `finality_checkpoints` of the head state.

Step.description: Protocol time after a time command.

mode.description: Honest executes every duty; fast permits empty slots and their inactivity penalties.

kill.description: `stopClient`/`restartClient`: crash the client instead of a graceful stop.

managed.description: The key is present in the managed VC.

online.description: The key is present and enabled, so the validator performs its duties.

operation.description: A failed snapshot operation; it may still contain a published snapshot or generation.

ControlError.description: Error document of a failed control request.

accounts.description: Explicit allocations; an entry for the default development account replaces it.

mnemonicAccounts.description: Fund the first `count` addresses of the managed development mnemonic.

spec.description: Network config values only; the mainnet preset stays fixed.

gloasForkEpoch.description: Epoch at which Gloas activates; earlier epochs run Fulu. Defaults to genesis.

blobSchedule.description:
Blob parameter only (BPO) schedule for EL and CL, at most 5 entries in epoch order. Replaces
the generator's default schedule; `baseFeeUpdateFraction` 0 or omitted lets it be derived.

balance.description: Integer wei, or whole ether such as "1000ETH".

GenesisAccount.description: One EL genesis allocation: a funded wallet, or a contract when code/storage are present.

balance.description: Integer gwei, or whole ether such as "2048ETH". Defaults to 32 ETH.

withdrawal.description: Defaults to 0x01 credentials for the funded development account.

mnemonic.description: Keys from this BIP-39 mnemonic instead of the managed development mnemonic.

start.description: First key index of `mnemonic` (default 0); managed keys continue from earlier groups.

online.description: false: the keys are in the VC but disabled from genesis, so the group never signs.

ValidatorGroup.description: Genesis validators with shared parameters; keys continue the managed mnemonic's indices.
